question: Please confirm that TP-E1 availability by 2028-07-15 is an Owner obligation under Sub-Clause 2.4 (so that a late line entitles the Contractor to an extension of time under Sub-Clause 9.4), and who coordinates the line energisation with the TSO.
response: Confirmed: availability of TP-E1 by 2028-07-15 is an Owner-furnished item under Sub-Clause 2.4; late availability entitles the Contractor to relief under Sub-Clause 9.4. The Owner energises the line with the TSO; the Contractor coordinates the plant-side protection settings and tests. TQ-010 is closed.
